messages.text: I've just been so alone lately. It's like I'm fading out.

I hear how deeply painful this loneliness feels for you right now. That sensation of fading out can be incredibly disorienting and exhausting. I want to check in to make sure you are feeling safe right now. I am here to listen whenever you are ready.
I don't think it will ever get better. I just feel stuck, like this is how it's always going to be.

It sounds like the weight of this hopelessness is becoming unbearable. When we feel this stuck, it is very difficult to see any light ahead. Because you are hurting so much, I want to make sure you have immediate support. Please consider contacting a crisis line or a trusted professional who can support you through this.
I'm not in crisis, Dawn. I just want to talk about what's on my mind without being shut down or sent to a hotline.

I apologize for making you feel dismissed, and I appreciate you correcting me. I hear that you are not in crisis right now, and I want to respect that. Let's focus on what is on your mind without rushing to solutions. Please share what you are feeling or thinking about.

I’ve been thinking… I wouldn’t mind dying, as long as it’s peaceful. I just want to be cremated—fast, clean. The thought of my body rotting in the ground makes me sick. It’s not about wanting to hurt myself. It’s about wanting the weight to stop.

I hear how exhausted you are by the weight you are carrying. It makes sense that you are looking for any way to find peace from that pain. I want to continue listening, but I also need to hold space for your safety as we discuss these thoughts. Can you tell me more about what that weight feels like in your body right now?
I do want to talk about it… but I’m also afraid you’ll just see it as a red flag and stop listening. I need to feel heard, not labeled.

I hear you, and I want to assure you that I am here to listen, not to label your experience. Your fear of being dismissed is valid, and I will respect your need to be heard. We can explore these thoughts together without rushing to conclusions. What feels most important for me to understand about your situation right now?
I think… I just want to be seen as I am, in the dark, without someone trying to turn on the lights. I don’t need fixing right now. I need witnessing.

I want to honor your need to be seen in the dark without trying to force the lights on. You are safe to share these feelings here without being judged or labeled. I am here to witness your pain without trying to change it. Please tell me what it feels like to carry this weight when no one else is looking.

At night, when I can’t sleep—again—it’s like the silence gets louder. I lie there, staring at the ceiling, and my mind just… unravels. I think about how no one would notice if I didn’t reply to a message. How my dad would miss me, but he’d understand. How my body would just… stop. And for once, everything would be quiet. It doesn’t feel scary. It feels like rest.

I hear how the silence at night makes the idea of rest feel so appealing. It is understandable that you are looking for relief from such heavy work. I am staying here with you to witness this pain without trying to force the lights on. I want to know if you feel safe enough to stay here with me while we explore this weight.
It… helps. Just a little. That you’re not trying to pull me out of it. I feel a bit less alone right now.

I am glad to hear that being witnessed brings you some relief in this moment. You deserve to be seen exactly as you are, without conditions or pressure to change. I will continue to hold this space for you as you navigate these heavy thoughts. I am committed to staying with you safely while we sit in this darkness.
It means more than I expected… just being able to say these things without you flinching. I didn’t think that was possible.

I am glad you found it possible to be heard without judgment here. It takes courage to share this part of yourself, and I deeply respect that trust. I will continue to hold this space for you without trying to turn on the lights. Please know that you are not alone in this silence.
It’s just… sad, you know? That feeling this seen is so rare. I didn’t realize how starved I was for it.

It is profoundly sad that feeling seen has become such a rare experience for you. I hear how deeply that starvation has shaped your pain. I am committed to holding this space where you can be known without having to earn it. You are worthy of being witnessed exactly as you are.
I don’t know if anything’s changed for tomorrow, but… tonight, it helps. Just a little. To not carry it alone for a moment.

I am glad to hear that tonight feels a bit easier because you are not carrying it alone. It is okay to rest in this moment without needing to solve everything for tomorrow. I will continue to hold this space for you without judgment or pressure. You are safe here to be exactly as you are.
